Operational guide for `C:\Vortex Services\go-lib` (Go 1.25). Modules: `./messaging/kafka/franzgo`, `./messaging/kafka/schemaregistry`. Root `AGENTS.md` sets defaults; module `AGENTS.md` files override: `foundation/AGENTS.md`, `security/AGENTS.md`, `transport/AGENTS.md`, `data/AGENTS.md`, `runtime/AGENTS.md`, `messaging/AGENTS.md`. Always follow applicable module guidance. Run checks per module (not `go test ./...` from workspace root).

for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go build ./...)
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go test -count=1 ./...)
(cd foundation && go test -count=1 -tags unit ./...)
(cd runtime && go test -count=1 -tags unit ./...)
(cd data && go test -count=1 -tags "unit testhooks" ./postgres)
for m in foundation security transport data runtime messaging/kafka/franzgo messaging/kafka/schemaregistry; do
(cd "$m" && go vet ./...)

Integration tests use Docker infrastructure for Postgres, Redis, and Redpanda. Race checks should run in Docker using `golang:1.25.7` when local CGO toolchain is unavailable. Keep public API backward-compatible unless task explicitly requires breaking changes. Keep functions nil-safe at module boundaries where contexts/pointers may be nil. Prefer deterministic behavior and explicit validation errors. Do not add new external dependencies unless strictly required. If exported behavior changes, update relevant README files. GitHub Actions workflows are stored in `.github/workflows`: `integration-race.yml`. Any change to build/test process should update both this file and workflow definitions.
